description: This plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) on the y-axis, which ranges from 30 to 70, against the number of epochs on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 6. The y-axis is linearly scaled, and the x-axis is also linearly scaled with integer tick marks at each epoch. Five distinct lines represent different fine-tuning configurations: “tiny AdalLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers), “tiny AdalLoRA_int8” (dashed gray line with circle markers), “tiny int4” (solid gray line with square markers), “tiny int8” (dashed gray line with square markers), and “tiny full” (dotted gray line with triangle markers). All lines show a general downward trend in WER as epochs increase. At epoch 0, the WER values start at approximately 70 for “tiny AdalLoRA_int4,” 60 for “tiny AdalLoRA_int8,” 50 for “tiny int4,” 50 for “tiny int8,” and 30 for “tiny full.” By epoch 6, these values decrease to approximately 33, 38, 35, 37, and 27, respectively. The “tiny full” configuration consistently achieves the lowest WER throughout training, while the “tiny AdalLoRA_int4” configuration starts with the highest WER and shows the steepest initial decline.
